verdict.rationale: Pydantic Evals is a first-party, code-first evaluation framework that grades agent outputs and full tool-call trajectories against datasets (docs-13, docs-21, docs-57), and Logfire-based eval tooling lets you 'run the suite from your code' and compare candidate vs baseline (docs-51, docs-52), which is straightforward to wire into CI since everything is plain Python. missing for 10: an explicit CI pipeline example/config, and independent/hands-on confirmation that evals are actually run in CI by real teams.
